plan: Keep queueing midlane as primary — it is already Willy's usual queue AND best role at 51.4% over 419 games (overall is 50.7%).
Two-hero rule for the climb: Lt. Belica and Zinx. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Willy wins about 5.2 and 2.6 more games per 100 on them.
Willy's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 41% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Willy is at 498 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 903 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Willy is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 50%. Past 32: 38%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 8 of 16 short games vs 6 of 16 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Willy's best
insights.finding: Willy's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 54% over 389 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: Gadget is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 237 games on Gadget at 50.3% — the field averages 49.5%. The comfort is real; the edge is roughly neutral.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: 1 pentakill in real 5v5s and a longest spree of 23 (plus 1 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Willy has receipts.

insights.title: Willy punches back after losses
insights.finding: Willy wins MORE right after a loss (48%) than after a win (33%). Tilt is not the problem; complacency might be.
insights.receipt: 11/23 after losses vs 6/18 after wins, last 42 games
